# rustinion_group_vm_snapshot_policy (Resource)

Manages a group's VM-aware upgrade policy. For devices that are VMs on a Proxmox VE or libvirt/KVM host Rustinion also manages (matched by SMBIOS UUID, MAC address or hostname), the host snapshots the VM before a firmware upgrade or an OS-update install, the upgrade waits for the verified snapshot, and the device page offers a rollback to it. When the host can't take one, the upgrade goes ahead with the configuration backup only. Only Rustinion's own snapshots (rustinion-pre-...) are pruned, down to keep per VM. Destroying this resource puts the defaults back (on, keep 2).



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `group_id` (String) The group this policy belongs to.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Snapshot the VM on its managed hypervisor before upgrades. Default true.
- `keep` (Number) Rustinion snapshots kept per VM, 1-10. Default 2.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as group_id.
